title.en: MALACANANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES DIRECTING THE DEPUTY EXECUTIVE SECRETARY FOR FINANCE AND ADMINISTRATION OF THE OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT TO SIT AS EX- OFFICIO MEMBER OF THE PAGCOR BOARD OF DIRECTORS

text.en:
The Deputy Executive Secretary for Finance and Administration,
Office of the President, shall sit as ex-officio member of the PAGCOR Board of Directors.

All orders, rules and regulations and issuances or parts thereof which
are inconsistent with this Order are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediatelv.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 21st day of
our Lord, two thousand and nine.
in the vear of
By the President:
EDÚARDO R. ÉRMITA
Executive Secretary
